info.name: Kirana Kart - Backend APIs (Auth, Addresses, Catalogue, Shops)
info.description: Complete production-ready API collection for Kirana Kart quick-commerce platform: Customer Authentication, Address Management, Delivery Serviceability, Location Search, Home Banners, Categories, Products, and Shops.

request.description: Requests an OTP challenge for customer registration.
Verifies signup OTP ('123456' accepted in development) and returns one-time signup ticket.
Creates customer account in MongoDB using signup ticket and issues JWT & refresh tokens.
Requests an OTP for an existing customer to login.
Verifies login OTP ('123456' accepted in development) and returns one-time login ticket.
Authenticates existing customer via login ticket and creates an active session.
Fetches profile of currently authenticated customer using JWT.
Updates approved profile fields. Mobile number updates are strictly rejected.
Rotates refresh token and returns a new access token.
Revokes current session and invalidates refresh token.
Lists saved addresses for the authenticated customer. Default address returned first.

request.description: Creates an address for the authenticated customer. Evaluates serviceability and saves addressId to collection variables.
Fetches a single address by ID. Enforces customer ownership (returns 404 if not owned).
Partially updates an address. Protected fields are rejected, and address changes re-trigger geocoding and serviceability checks.
Sets the specified address as default and unsets any previous default atomically.
Deletes an address. If the deleted address was default, reassigns default to the most recently updated remaining address.
Evaluates delivery serviceability for a customer's saved address.
Evaluates delivery serviceability directly using GPS coordinates against polygon service boundaries.
Pre-check serviceability before saving an address using postal code and coordinates.
Searches locations via geocoding provider (Google Places / Mock) and attaches serviceability.
Searches places biased towards user's current GPS position.
Loads active and scheduled home promotional banners for the selected service area.

exec: var pulses = json.data.items.find(function(c) { return c.slug === 'pulses' || (c.name && c.name.toLowerCase().indexOf('pulse') !== -1); });

request.description: Lists top-level active categories with optional nested subcategories.
Fetches category details by category ID.
Returns active child subcategories of the specified category.
Lists products assigned to a category with optional shop pricing and inventory.
Browse and search products across keywords, brand, category, with price sorting and shop inventory.
Fetches product details, images, brand, category, and shop-specific pricing.
Fetches all pack sizes and SKUs for a product with available inventory and MRP/selling price.
Evaluates purchasing availability based on shop operating hours, order acceptance, and stock.
Returns related active products based on shared category or brand.

item.name: 1. Find Available Shops (by PIN / Service Area)

request.description: Finds eligible active shops for a delivery location.
Finds open shops whose service area polygon encompasses the GPS coordinates.
Returns public shop address, contact phone, operating hours, and live open status.
Authoritative product catalogue scoped to the selected shop with shop-specific prices and inventory.
Calculates whether a shop is currently open and accepting orders in its local timezone.
Searches grocery products across names, brands, keywords, SKUs, and categories with ranking and availability.
Search grocery products with category filter, in-stock filtering, and ascending price sorting.
Returns lightweight autocomplete suggestions across product names, categories, and brands.
Returns popular search queries aggregated from actual search events over the last 7 days.
Filters products by category with pagination.
Sorts products by price ascending with deterministic tie-breaking.
Returns only products currently in stock.
Demonstrates combined category filtering, stock check, price sorting, and pagination.
